slides.title: 4 GTA 6 SETTINGS TO CHANGE
slides.sub: Do these before your first mission.

slides.head: WHY BOTHER
slides.body: A few defaults get in the way of reading text, spotting turns, or recording clean video.

slides.head: SUBTITLES
slides.body: Set subtitles to show outside missions too.

slides.head: MINIMAP
slides.body: Keep it always on while you learn the map.

slides.head: TEXT SIZE
slides.body: Small is the default. Go Medium or Large if you sit far from the screen.

slides.head: MUSIC
slides.body: Streaming or recording? Turn on Mute Licensed Music.
